headlines.text: Back on this day in 2021, Darby Allin vs. Ten put the AEW TNT Title on the line, appearing on Dynamite, rated 5.64. For Ten, it marked a first real shot at championship gold. Every title match carries a little extra weight, and this one was no exception.
Rewind to 2023, when it was Spears & Starks's first night in AEW as a team, appearing on Rampage, rated 6.14.
Rewind to 2021, when Dustin Rhodes made their return to AEW television after 7 weeks away, appearing on Dynamite.

secondaries.text: Flash back to 2021, when Penelope Ford returned to the fold after just over 3 months away, appearing on Dynamite.
2023 brought us this moment: it was a long-awaited, welcome sight as Ashley D'Amboise returned to the ring after just over 9 months away, appearing on Rampage.
2021 brought us this moment: Mike Sydal stepped back through the curtain after 7 weeks away, appearing on Dynamite.
